text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Run! Run! To the place I've dreamed of...! To the sight waiting beyond the goal!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena!" "Go!" "Gooo...!"
"Buena-chan!" "You can do it!" "Go!!"
"Buena Vistaaaaa!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you!!
Let's reach it together—all of us!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: To a wonderful, breathtaking view—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I won.
I actually won... I did it...!!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Why am I...
crying...?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO...! That was an incredible race...! *Sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... It hurts like I ran
at full sprint... but—I'm so happy... !!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So these are—
Buena-chan's true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaaaa!
Thank youuuu!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's eyes are sparkling...
Every single one is so dazzling...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(How beautiful,
and how deeply moving...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So this is what it was.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Spe-san's breathtaking view was conquering the world.
Vodka-chan's breathtaking view... was born from shattering conventional wisdom.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Our magnificent view is—
a much more honest... pure scenery.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I run with all my might...
and everyone loves me for it.
And you're right by my side, watching over me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, myself, and you.
A magnificent view where all our feelings become one.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
This is... the breathtaking view we've all been aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside Buena Vista,
I look up at the spectator stands...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—I realized something was trickling down my cheek.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I'm sure we have the exact same look in our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey,
we've finally made it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: To a breathtaking view beyond anything we ever dreamed of that day—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Buena Vista returned,
her eyes were brimmed with tears.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: Thank you for keeping your promise.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Likewise!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for bringing me
to our promised place—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the lingering awe of the magnificent view,
we take our time on the path home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are no words. So as not to overwrite
the scenery I just witnessed with some other phrasing...
I simply savor it in silence.
choice_data_list: (We made our dream come true... didn't we, partner?)
(We really made our dream come true... didn't we?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, all of a sudden—
Buena Vista came to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
There's... a race I want to run in next."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"A second Arima Kinen. And there...
there's another sight I want to see."
choice_data_list: A sight you want to see?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I feel like... I'll definitely get to see it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If you were to run solely for yourself...
what would give you strength?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —...My—our magnificent view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...There were tears today, but...
Over there... I'm sure I'll be smiling."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "This time with a smile... I want to see that other breathtaking view with you, one that only you and I can share."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What on earth is that...?" I swallow the urge
to ask. She can already see it...
Then I'm sure I'll understand soon enough too.
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's run the Arima Kinen too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...Look forward to it, okay?
